$comment: users.messages.list -> GET gmail/v1/users/{userId}/messages, response ListMessagesResponse. Read from the discovery document 2026-10-01. Each row is an id/threadId pair only -- Gmail's list endpoint has never returned subject/from/snippet, by design, so a host reads message_get per id for content.
title: List Gmail messages
description: List message ids matching a search, newest first.

config.label: Mailbox
config.description: `me` is the connected account and is almost always what you want.

config.label: Search
config.description: Gmail's own search syntax, exactly as typed into the Gmail search box -- e.g. "from:ada@example.test has:attachment newer_than:7d". Leave blank to list everything.

config.label: Label ID
config.description: Only messages with this label -- e.g. INBOX, or a label_list id. Gmail's own query parameter accepts several, repeated; this connector offers one for now -- combine more in the search field above instead, using Gmail's own label: search operator.

outputShape.description: Each row is { id, threadId } only. Read a message's content with message_get.
Present when there is another page.
Gmail's own word for it: an ESTIMATE, not an exact count.
Which estate this ran against. Google has no sandbox, so: fake or live.
